text:
jordana: Quick sync — we need to lock down the micro-FAQ copy + pricing calculator flows for next week's webinar. Prototype: https://proto.redwood/pricing-calc-v2 :wave:

alex: Link loads for me. Two decisions: tier names + default commit slider wording. Are we doing an A/B on names?

samir: From product POV, 'Starter / Scale / Enterprise' feels generic. Proposal: 'Dev / Team / Dedicated' — shorter and maps to deployment modes. Also want a monthly/annual toggle in the calc.

li: I can draft the FAQ. Priorities: billing unit explanation, reserved capacity vs shared, what quantization means for perf. Draft snippet below — will expand:```
Q: How are tokens billed?
A: Per-request token accounting (prompt + completion). We estimate monthly based on your avg prompt length in the calculator.

Q: What is Dedicated capacity?
A: Reserved GPU pools with guaranteed throughput and data isolation.
```

chris: Ops note — inbound routing for webinar leads: route all signups with campaign=pricing-webinar to Growth SDR queue, tag as "pricing-webinar"; if they select Dedicated or request a demo, also notify CSMs + account team. Sample webhook rule documented in #eng-infra.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar deploy window scheduled for 4467000000. Please confirm any /pricing redirect changes 48h before.

alex: Agree on max two name variants for the A/B. Also request that the calc shows cost delta with caching enabled vs disabled (this will be our benchmark narrative in the webinar).

jordana: Action items: li — FAQ draft by EOD; samir — implement name variants in calc prototype; chris/ops — add routing rule and webhook; alex — create A/B flag and analytics goal. Quick check: everyone ok with that? :slightly_smiling_face:

samir: OK from product, will drop names into prototype by today afternoon.

li: On it — will post copy and short FAQ table in this thread when ready.

chris: Routing ticket created: INF-3247. Tagging Growth and CSM.

alex: I'll set up the experiment in LaunchDarkly and wire the dashboard. Goal: % signups -> trial and Avg $/seat.

jordana: Perfect. If no objections, we'll ship the micro-FAQ + calc tweak as part of the webinar landing experience. :thumbsup:
